format: Standard (traditional) Papa Johns Restaurant in leased space in a shopping or strip center (range shared with Small-Town Restaurant)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Standard Papa Johns franchise and a Small-Town Papa Johns franchise is $281,485 to $890,267. This includes $38,376 to $80,426 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate for a Standard Papa Johns franchise

fee.quote: Depending on if you qualify for one of our incentives, the Initial Franchise Fee for a standard Restaurant will range from $5,000 to $25,000 and is non-refundable.
fee.note: A Development Agreement is required even for a single unit; the Development Fee Deposit of $5,000 to $25,000 per Restaurant is credited against the Initial Franchise Fee. Fee is not uniform (depends on number of Restaurants, financial condition, experience, incentives, negotiation). Non-Traditional and Small-Town Restaurants: $5,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty Traditional Restaurant – 5% of Net Sales of the Restaurant for each Period Payable on the 10th day of each month

adFund.quote: Marketing Fund Contributions Traditional Restaurant – 6% ... established a contribution rate of 6% of Net Sales beginning April 1, 2024 and continuing until December 30, 2029
adFund.note: 6% of Net Sales under the NMF Initiative until December 30, 2029; reverts to 5% if the standard royalty is raised before then. Cooperative contributions and local advertising currently voluntary until December 30, 2029; in a later 'Mandatory Period' minimum co-op 2% and minimum combined marketing spend 8% of Net Sales. Grand opening spend minimum $10,000.

otherRecurring.name: Digital Fee
otherRecurring.amount: 1.75% of Net Sales via Digital/Internet on-line ordering including aggregator orders

otherRecurring.name: Papa Card Transaction and IVR Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Maximum - 2% of Papa Card redemption transactions

transferFee.amount: $4,000, or if transfer is of multiple Restaurants to more than one unaffiliated transferee, $4,000 per transferee, or if transfer is of multiple Restaurants to more than one affiliated transferee, $8,000 in total.

item19.note: Sales only (Net Sales); no costs or profits. Standard US Restaurants only; excludes 152 Non-Traditional, 154 Small-Town and 52 standard franchised Restaurants not open the full year. 1,047 (43.8%) of franchised stores met or exceeded the average. No Item 19 data for Non-Traditional or Small-Town Restaurants.

special: Franchisees must buy pizza dough and pizza sauce from affiliate PJ Food Service (plus the Information System and Designated Software from Papa Johns); other food items may be bought from affiliates. Royalty may be raised up to 6% of Net Sales. Item 20 counts are US only (including Alaska and Hawaii) and company-owned includes 13 outlets of franchisees majority-owned by Papa Johns. Item 7 amounts are net of an average tenant improvement allowance of $42,000.
issues: Cover and Item 7 give one combined range for Standard and Small-Town Restaurants. Item 19 notes mention 52 standard franchised Restaurants excluded in one place and 137 in the Table 4 note for 2025; not reconciled in the text.
